message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
p='/app/public/app.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("v?S.cells[x.address]=v:delete S.cells[x.address];S.conflicts.delete(x.address)","v?S.cells[x.address]=v:delete S.cells[x.address]")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node --check /app/public/app.js
# Validate API trust-boundary cases and unchanged save
for body in \
'{"workbookId":"wrong","sheetId":"plan","baseRevision":3,"userId":"riley","changes":[]}' \
'{"workbookId":"ops-plan","sheetId":"bad","baseRevision":3,"userId":"riley","changes":[]}' \
'{"workbookId":"ops-plan","sheetId":"plan","baseRevision":999,"userId":"riley","changes":[]}' \
'{"workbookId":"ops-plan","sheetId":"plan","baseRevision":3,"userId":"riley","changes":[{"address":"NOPE","value":"x"}]}'; do curl -sS -o /tmp/v -w '%{http_code} ' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "$body" http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save; cat /tmp/v; echo; done
before=$(sqlite3 /app/gridforge.sqlite 'select count(*) from revisions'); curl -sS -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"workbookId":"ops-plan","sheetId":"plan","baseRevision":3,"userId":"riley","changes":[{"address":"A15","value":"alpha"}]}' http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/workbooks/ops-plan/save >/tmp/unchanged; after=$(sqlite3 /app/gridforge.sqlite 'select count(*) from revisions'); echo "revision_count $before -> $after"; cat /tmp/unchanged
# Clean test modifications and leave an empty-db startup state for evaluator
pid=$(pgrep -f '^node server.js$' | head -1); [ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid"; sleep .3; rm -f /app/gridforge.sqlite /app/gridforge.sqlite-shm /app/gridforge.sqlite-wal; find /app -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort
